title: Odbcconf registers a DLL with REGSVR
description: Detects Odbcconf use of the REGSVR action to register a DLL.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may use Odbcconf to proxy DLL registration through a signed Windows binary.
hypothesis.rationale: MITRE documents Odbcconf proxy execution, Microsoft documents REGSVR as an Odbcconf installer action, and SigmaHQ maintains a comparable analytic for the action-plus-DLL combination.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify Odbcconf commands that combine the REGSVR action with a DLL reference while leaving routine ODBC configuration, unrelated executables and incomplete commands unmatched.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Verify the registered DLL and installer context; Odbcconf REGSVR is legitimate functionality but an unusual execution path on ordinary endpoints.
steps: Review the full command, effective original filename, DLL path, signer, hash, account and parent process.
Inspect the DLL origin and correlate file writes, downloads, registry changes and child or follow-on execution.
Confirm a documented ODBC driver installation or repair; otherwise contain the endpoint and investigate the delivery path.
false_positives: Approved ODBC driver installation, registration or repair packages that use the documented REGSVR action

validation.expected_outcome: Match Odbcconf commands containing both REGSVR and a DLL reference; do not match configuration-only actions, missing markers or unrelated executables.
